properties.summary: Illustrative massing. The two buildings built so far are drawn from their permits: Block X (1101 Connecticut St, 72 homes, Phase 1), drawn at its block's 50-ft limit, and Block B (157 homes, Phase 2), drawn as its block at the 65-ft cap the standards allow on part of it. The other 22 zones are drawn to the height limits of the adopted Design Standards and Guidelines (30 to 65 ft), not as building designs. The old public housing stays in the base map; streets and parks aren't drawn.
properties.note: Unbuilt blocks are drawn to their height limits, not as building designs.

controls.label: Figure 5.1's dashed project boundary to the Special Use District boundary: trimmed RMS over the closest 80% of 3068 points

sources.heights: Potrero HOPE SF Design Standards and Guidelines (November 2016), Figure 5.1, Zoning Height Diagram, p. 67 (PDF page 70); DSG 5.1.1

blocks.mohcd: MOHCD Loan Committee, Potrero HOPE SF Phase III predevelopment loan evaluation (Apr 4, 2025), https://media.api.sf.gov/documents/Approved-Potrero_HOPE_SF_Phase_III_Predevelopment_Loan_Evaluation_LC_4-04-2025.pdf ("Out of the 157 units at Block B", p. 7; "at 1101 Connecticut, a 72-unit", p. 22)
blocks.phase2: SF Planning, Potrero HOPE SF Phase 2 approval (Oct 13, 2017), https://sfplanning.s3.amazonaws.com/default/files/devagreements/HOPE-SF/Potrero/HOPE-SF_Potrero_Phase2_Approval_20171013.pdf ("Potrero HOPE SF Vertical Development Summary Table", p. 13; "Temporary Certificate of Occupancy Received for Block X", p. 21)

properties.license: Zones traced from the DSG (SF Planning); boundary and permits from DataSF (Public Domain); footprints OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL 1.0), via Overture Maps.

properties.label: Block B, 1801 25th St
properties.source: illustrative: the block's zone in Potrero HOPE SF Design Standards and Guidelines (November 2016), Figure 5.1, Zoning Height Diagram, p. 67, standing in for the building's footprint, which OpenStreetMap doesn't map yet; 7 stories in DBI permit 202006108345; drawn to the DSG's Block B cap (Control 5.1.1 No. 6: "In no case is any portion of any building greater than 65-feet") over its 50-ft limit, since parts above 50 ft are limited to 30% of the block
properties.note: DBI permit 202006108345, complete 2025-12-04. Block: MOHCD's Phase III loan evaluation (Apr 2025): "Out of the 157 units at Block B". The Phase 2 approval's table (Oct 2017) listed 40 ft for Block B. Drawn as its block: the building's own footprint isn't mapped yet.

properties.label: Block X, 1101 Connecticut St
properties.source: illustrative: footprint from OpenStreetMap via Overture 2026-09-23.1 (OSM w1246126991@2); 5 stories in DBI permit 201603172392; drawn to Block X's 50-ft limit in Figure 5.1
properties.note: DBI permit 201603172392, complete 2019-10-28. Block: MOHCD's Phase III loan evaluation: "completed Phase I construction and lease-up at 1101 Connecticut, a 72-unit" building; the Phase 2 approval lists Phase 1 as Block X, 72 units. Block X is outside the Special Use District and the development agreement's Project Area.
